description: A shell script for testing git-cvsserver modes, especially handling of binary files, line ending attributes, and file status operations in a git/cvs integration environment.

methods.name: marked_as
methods.description: Checks whether a specific file in a directory is marked with the expected CVS status, such as binary (-kb) or text.

methods.name: not_present
methods.description: Verifies that a specific file is absent in the CVS working directory.

methods.name: check_status_options
methods.description: Runs CVS status with specified options and verifies output against expected status.
